解答 由极坐标方程可得参数方程 $\left\{\begin{array}{l}x=\frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cos\theta\csc\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\\y=\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta+\sin\theta}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\sin\theta\csc\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\end{array}\right.$ 两边同时对 $\theta$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{d\theta}=-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\sin\theta\csc\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cos\theta\csc\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\cot\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right),$$

$$\frac{dy}{d\theta}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cos\theta\csc\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\sin\theta\csc\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\cot\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right),$$

可得 $\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/d\theta}{dx/d\theta}=-\frac{\cos\theta-\sin\theta\cot\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta\cot\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}=-1.$
